review_scope_note: Unlike prior API-based reviews that saw only the finding text, this audit had full repository access: experiment kernels, archived run logs/CSVs, prior reviews, remediations, and paper/CERTIFICATE.md where applicable. Quantitative claims were checked against primary artifacts; arithmetic and hashes were recomputed where feasible. No computational result was invented.
verification_methods: Read check_transitivity.cu and finding frontmatter hedges
Searched for archived run log of the 2000-prime BFS
Cross-checked det(g_a)=-1 ambient-group issue against prior remediations

claim_reviews.claim: Kernel checks orbit size p^2-1 under generators g_a and inverses.
claim_reviews.evidence: Method in scripts/experiments/zaremba-transitivity/check_transitivity.cu matches the described BFS.

claim_reviews.claim: 0 non-transitive primes among the first 2000 primes (p≤17389).
claim_reviews.evidence: No saved run log/hash is present in the checkout to machine-check the finite claim.
claim_reviews.concerns: The computation is plausible and the code exists; publish the log.

claim_reviews.claim: Generators lie in SL2(F_p) / the action is an SL2 theorem for all primes.
claim_reviews.evidence: det g_a = -1, so full generator set is in GL2, not SL2. Frontmatter now warns about GL/PGL / even-word SL2; residual SL2 theorem language should stay out.

claim_reviews.claim: Dickson-classification argument gives a complete all-prime proof.
claim_reviews.evidence: Page correctly calls this provisional. Cartan/exceptional exclusions and ambient-group formulation still need independent group-theoretic verification. Treat as a proof strategy, not a theorem.

claim_reviews.claim: Finite claim: no local obstruction found through p=17389.
claim_reviews.evidence: This is the right claim shape, but needs a reproducible log/checksum before VERIFIED.

missing_references: Archived BFS log for first 2000 primes with checksum
Dickson classification primary sources; ambient-group-correct writeup
overall_assessment: The page's current provisional posture is scientifically appropriate. The finite computational claim is unreproducible without a log, and any all-prime theorem claim remains out of reach until the det=-1 ambient-group issue is cleaned up and independently checked.
recommendations: Solicit independent group-theory review of the Dickson argument
certification_justification: Finite computational strategy plus a provisional algebraic sketch — bronze. Not silver while the finite run is unpublished and the all-prime argument is provisional.
